title: Surreal Figure with Bird Mask
description: A surreal painting features a stern young boy with a buzz cut and dark eyes in the foreground. Behind him stands a tall composite figure wearing a green textured coat, black-rimmed glasses, and a large bird-of-prey mask made of seeds or pods with a long beak, set against a cosmic background with magenta flowers, a bleeding broken heart, and running hares.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting featuring a stern young boy with a buzz cut and large dark eyes in the foreground, behind him a tall mysterious figure wearing a green textured coat, black glasses, and an elaborate bird mask constructed from seed pods with a long dark beak. A large broken white heart drips blood on the left. Two brown hares run across the scene. Background transitions from deep magenta floral patterns to a starry purple cosmic sky. Dark, melancholic and eerie atmosphere.
